get_lr_at_epoch: get the learning rate for a given epoch with optional warmup schedule applied
lr_func_cosine: compute the cosine annealing learning rate for a given training epoch
lr_func_steps_with_relative_lrs: compute the step-based learning rate using relative LR multipliers for a given epoch
get_step_index: retrieve the learning rate step index for a given training epoch
get_lr_func: retrieve the learning rate policy function by its string name
